content: Dexie transaction for atomic write across two tables: db.transaction('rw', db.medicines, db.history, async () => { await db.medicines.update(id, changes); await db.history.add(entry); }). Mode 'rw' for read-write. If the async function throws, the entire transaction rolls back. Nested transactions supported — inner tables must be a subset of outer tables. Use db.transaction() when medicine update and history insert must be atomic.
